cases.sentence: Если ты откажешься и будешь удерживать их дальше, 3 рука Господа поразит ___ твой скот в поле: лошадей, ослов, верблюдов, быков и коров, овец и коз.
cases.explain: «страшным мором» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For if you refuse to let them go, and hold them still,

cases.explain: «следующий день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Yahweh did that thing on the next day; and all the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

cases.sentence: Она тонкой пылью будет витать над всем Египтом, и по всей стране на людях и на скоте появятся ___.
cases.explain: «гнойные нарывы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It shall become small dust over all the land of Egypt, and shall be a boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal, throughout all the land of Egypt.”

cases.sentence: Моисей бросил золу в воздух, и на людях и скоте появились ___.
cases.explain: «гнойные нарывы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They took ashes of the furnace, and stood before Pharaoh; and Moses sprinkled it up toward the sky; and it became boils and blisters breaking on man and on animal.

cases.sentence: На этот раз Я накажу тебя, твоих приближенных и твой народ самыми ___, чтобы ты знал: нет на земле подобного Мне.
cases.explain: «страшными карами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: For this time I will send all my plagues against your heart, against your officials, and against your people; that you may know that there is no one like me in all the earth.

cases.sentence: Так слушай: завтра в это время Я пошлю такой ___, какого Египет не знал со времен своего основания.
cases.explain: «страшный град» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Behold, tomorrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail, such as has not been in Egypt since the day it was founded even until now.

cases.sentence: Помолитесь Господу; довольно с нас ___ и града!
cases.explain: «ужасного грома» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Pray to Yahweh; for there has been enough of mighty thunderings and hail. I will let you go, and you shall stay no longer.”
